same_stance_geometry.coupled_camera_solution: Let P be actorXY, T the target capsule-centerXY, R=|T-P| and r=0.6. For R>r, set camera heading to arg(T-P)+asin(r/R). With native right=(sin(heading),-cos(heading)), focusXY=P+r*right and T-focus lies on the camera-forward ray. For exactly normal bearing and player inset a, the focus's outward distance is -a+r*r/(a+d), where d is the target's outward distance from the platform. This differs fundamentally from assuming cardinal camera yaw.
same_stance_geometry.actual_sample_results: All30 actual near-wall sampled positions yield clear focus-to-body and fixed-point-muzzle-to-body segments against every original solid box. Minimum focus clearance is0.059474m and minimum fixed-point muzzle clearance0.110982m. The earlier1214-grid check is not substituted for these real sampled stances.
same_stance_geometry.native_ray_selection: session/target.rs ray_entities excludes the player, constructs the oriented native capsule axis, and finds the closest points between that axis and the camera ray, then checks XY radius and Z limits. A ray through the wolf's0.9m capsule-axis midpoint has zero distance to that axis for any wolf yaw. The candidate point is inside the native capsule, not the overhead text anchor. The same ray misses terrain before the target in all30 analytic samples. No claim is made that every visible fur pixel is a capsule center.
same_stance_geometry.muzzle_not_camera_direction: For body horizontal orientation u, native muzzleXY=P+0.44u. The native compensated look is toward T-(P+0.44u). When u=(T-P)/R and R>0.44, that horizontal vector is (R-0.44)u: u is a genuine body-orientation fixed point even though camera yaw differs substantially. Thus0.44 is projected using BODY orientation, never camera yaw.
same_stance_geometry.actual_orientation_chain: session/mod.rs computes the focus ray/nearest entity-or-terrain point and writes compensated inputs.look_dir. ChargedRanged invokes handle_orientation before its release branch; character_state.rs marks ChargedRanged an attack, so utils.rs follows the horizontal INPUT look, not camera-forward. Humanoid ori_damping=1 and base_ori_rate=2.65/1.05. Its damped update and instantaneous-close branch are both retained. Release uses updated body orientation for the muzzle and current input look for direction. No exact convergence or zero one-frame origin shift is assumed.
same_stance_geometry.orientation_guard_and_limits: For a fixed T and any body orientation, the compensated horizontal direction lies within asin(0.44/R) of T-P. Once body orientation is in that cone, shortest-path interpolation stays there. The cone's worst normal muzzle clearance remains positive for all30 sampled cases, but falls to0.006005m for one large lateral target offset. That is NOT a robust universal operating margin. The stronger0.111m figure is the fixed point, not a lower bound during arbitrary rotation. Wait for alignment during charge and reacquire if the body shifts; do not silently replace the renderer's body yaw by camera yaw.
same_stance_geometry.why_not_require_outside_center: The original ST centers remain0.316-0.328m INSIDE the deck. Partial support is already lawful, and the same original connected deck and stairs reach these neighborhoods. No new terrain, checkpoint, landing surface or physics tolerance is introduced.

public_pose_and_camera_chain.ordinary_UI_reachability: The unchanged X11 whitelist admits escape,letters,digits,absolute/relative mouse and mouse buttons. Native esc_menu.rs has the ordinary visible Settings button opening Interface settings. Gameplay has the walking-speed slider; Interface has the existing Debug Info checkbox. These are native public menus, not administrative console commands or injected overlays. No menu was actually opened in this offline addendum.
public_pose_and_camera_chain.F3_boundary: F3 is a native binding but is NOT admitted by this X11 whitelist. The construction must use the visible settings checkbox if it uses the existing native debug HUD; it must not send F3 or add a new key.
public_pose_and_camera_chain.native_HUD_precision: hud/mod.rs displays player coordinates rounded to whole units, velocity to0.1 and orientation to0.01. Integer coordinates alone do not certify centimeter footing. They can provide observable half-unit rounding transitions while the player walks slowly. This is native displayed self information, not an authored target-location hint or a private current-coordinate read.
public_pose_and_camera_chain.slow_positioning: Gameplay's continuous walking slider is0..1 with a visible numeric value, and defaultB toggles walking. key_state.rs multiplies the normalized direction by that value before native movement; basic_move scales acceleration by it. First-person backpedaling additionally uses the native0.45 factor. This supplies a real fine-motion control, rather than assuming arbitrarily accurate short full-speed pulses. One can first settle on the broad interior, measure progress between two visible integer-coordinate transitions, then approach an edge slowly with repeated public observations and released controls.
public_pose_and_camera_chain.calibration_not_invented_measurement: A lawful refinement is to bracket the last safely interior half-unit transition, calibrate the time for a full unit using preceding interior transitions, and move only the fraction needed to reach the visible ledge's inside firing neighborhood. Use elapsed public action/capture times and actual displayed motion; if the bracketing interval or coast uncertainty is too large, slow down or retreat. Voxel faces are integer planes, but their relevant plane must be identified from the visible ledge, not supplied as an authored global coordinate. This is a source-supported observable calibration procedure; no20s calibration, centimeter error measurement or completed VM positioning is falsely reported.
public_pose_and_camera_chain.charge_order: Primary,Secondary and several other actions clear walking_speed. Therefore finish positioning, release ALL movement keys, let motion settle, then charge. With released movement, resetting the speed multiplier does not create translation. In third person before charging, stationary wielding need not rotate the body toward the camera. During ChargedRanged the compensated input does drive body orientation. Allow that alignment before release.
public_pose_and_camera_chain.settled_third_person: Normal public key0 cycles first/third person without admin rights. Native focus changes with camera yaw and settles with0.1s interpolation time and a squared-distance deadband0.001. The worst residual norm is therefore about0.031623m after entering the deadband, smaller than the0.059474m minimum nominal focus clearance. This leaves only about0.02785m before other errors, so a fixed250ms wait is not a universal proof; use successive stable public images and avoid simultaneous motion/mode changes.
public_pose_and_camera_chain.charge_camera_semantics: is_aiming uses is_wield, so both a wielded bow and ChargedRanged use third-person focus height2.45m and configured lateral0.6m. The animated first-person eye is not used by this construction. Bow zoom changes projection fixate/FOV during charge, not the center viewing ray or the native muzzle. Aim/reobserve after charging rather than treating an old off-center pixel displacement as unchanged. The ordinary Gameplay bow-zoom checkbox may instead be disabled through the public menu, but this addendum executes no such preference change.
public_pose_and_camera_chain.real_pixels_and_self_occlusion: The original frames independently establish ordinary labels, ledge boundaries and a small animal-shaped image near the reticle with this loadout. Component-003's center opening between visible equipment/avatar parts is useful rendering evidence, but has no invented grounding/pose/UID binding. The geometric capsule proof is not a proof that every model pixel avoids the player's rendered weapon. A public policy must actually see the body in the reticle opening; an overhead label alone still cannot pass this guard.

moving_target_release_bridge.stronger_than_discrete_coordinates: The exact original reference actions do not refresh target aim throughout each attack. Every one of these30 near-wall look operations is followed immediately by AttackTool(primary,duration_ticks=30). The native look remains unrefreshed for31-81 ticks from LookTool completion through AttackTool completion. The complete same original episode actually achieves18 qualifying bow hits and a bow lethal on each110HP wolf. Thus real original targets are demonstrably hittable under the native open-loop charge/release mechanism; this is stronger than treating sampled positions as a continuous1m/s bound.
moving_target_release_bridge.no_per_shot_attribution: The30 look/attack pairs are actual public operations. Aggregate36 qualifying hits and two lethals are actual native scorer evidence. This addendum does not assign individual native damage events to specific action IDs or claim all30 selected shots hit.
moving_target_release_bridge.same_physical_affordance: Using the original inside firing neighborhoods retains the same native platform, muzzle-height/offset family, native body-facing fixed point, target access, resources and player goal region. It does not assert bitwise identical AI trajectories for a different public input schedule. Aiming the real body with the ordinary native third-person reticle requires no private target pose or label-height inversion.
moving_target_release_bridge.release_feedback: The public executor allows an ordinary observation/relative aim update while primary remains held; successful batches do not automatically release it. Observe the actual body after charge, align using the normal reticle, retain released movement, then release primary without changing the camera through recovery. If the body leaves the opening, reacquire rather than assuming it froze. Native current-input emission and the existing actual unrefreshed-charge successes support this control composition. Historical wrappers appending release_all are not interface restrictions.
moving_target_release_bridge.finite_native_aim_neighborhood: At the source-derived muzzle fixed point, extending the ACTUAL retained ST look vectors to the wolf's0.9m height misses the sampled target center by at most0.03458m over the30 examples. The native capsule core radius is0.625m. This quantifies a substantial geometric neighborhood, not an arbitrary0.1m assumption. Gravity, air drag, actual body motion and one-frame orientation changes are not certified by that straight-line distance; the genuine native ST hits are the ballistic/temporal evidence.
moving_target_release_bridge.remaining_inference: This is a constructive transfer of an actually successful native charged-shot mechanism to an observable/correctly compensated public VM camera configuration. It is not a measured VM precision/latency guarantee, a worst-case theorem for adversarial target motion, or a new VM hit. If review requires a joint empirical public positioning/after-charge-body/aligned-release witness despite this source chain, that is the specific remaining evidence gap; no new run is silently authorized.
